summary: Vaxart filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $49,772,479 through agents Citizens JMP Securities and B. Riley Securities. Shares are sold at market prices on the OTCQX market with a 3% aggregate commission. No fixed price, premium, or special-situation features are present. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown under Rule 415. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural event triggers are involved. Not a special situation; it is an ordinary securities offering.
